**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear Sir
I should think [Miss Knapp](../persons.html#2110)’s story would have every chance of attention if you recommended it to [Mr Duncan](../persons.html#448) in person, I have always found that literary work stands on its own merits and on the actual opening for it.[^2]
I feel quite sure no recommendation from me would be of half the use of your requesting Canon Duncan to let his reader judge of the M S.

That is where the real decision lies, and this is the best time before their number of tales is filled up

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: Canon Duncan was the secretary of the [National Society](../others.html#32) which published stories for children.
